title: Amendment in SEBI (Mutual Funds) Regulations, 1996
text: Home »Legal»Circulars Amendment in SEBI (Mutual Funds) Regulations, 1996 Jun 20, 1997| Circulars D.CHANDA DIVISION CHIEF IIMARP/MF/CIR/11/1171/97 June 20, 1997 The Managing Director/ President/ Chief Executive Officer All Mutual Funds registered with SEBI Unit Trust of India/ AMFI Dear Sir, Sub : Amendment in SEBI (Mutual Funds) Regulations, 1996 Securities and Exchange Board of India (Mutual Funds) Regulations, 1996 have been amended which was notified on April 15, 1997. A copy of the notification* is enclosed for your information Yours faithfully, -sd- D.CHANDA Encl : a/a *Please see Amendment under "Regulations".
